name: ReplicationBench

results_over_time.note: Paper Table 2, unweighted score averaged over 6 runs. Paper scaffold is a simple code-sandbox tool-use loop (Python execution, file read/write, submit()) — not named, so system_description reports the generic descriptor. Best-of-N scores in the same table rise to 0.22–0.39. Paper also reports ReplicationBench-Plus (58 extra LLM-generated tasks on 11 additional papers).

notes: 20 reproducible, self-contained astrophysics papers decomposed into 111 research-level tasks. Each task rated on a 1–9 log-scale difficulty (minutes → weeks of human-expert effort). Task types: data loading/processing, summary statistics, model fitting, Bayesian inference, physical simulations, ML applications. Leaderboard search on 2026-04-20: no public leaderboard found (paper, GitHub README, and HuggingFace dataset page all checked) — `links.leaderboard` left null and no post-paper results added to results_over_time.
